conviction_note: Near-zero. H1 profit will be sharply down (Q1 OP -79%, Q2 月次 total sales -4 to -6%), but that is visible from public documents. What the release can add is the forecast decision on an FY OP plan of 17.0bn (+51.6%) that Q1 put only 3% of the way to. Fuji held its plan at H1 in each of the last three years and cut later, and all four regional supermarket peers that reported this season held theirs. So a hold, which has drawn flat-to-slightly-positive two-day reactions here, is more likely than a cut, which cost about -2.8% over two days in January 2026. The guidance finding nets to -0.3 on the cut risk, the visible-quarter finding to -0.1, so impact_sum is -0.4. The scaled number is -0.09 (p_up 48 x abs 2.3) because the margin book is short-heavy and H1 prints here have bounced the next day. The two measurements agree in sign; the scaled one is smaller because the lessons moved the uncertainty into p_up.

My H1 OP estimate is about 1.5-2.5bn, so -65% against that pace. That miss is computable from public data and the bar is the company's own and not the street's, so every finding is capped small.

findings.finding: Forecast decision. The FY27/2 plan (OP 17.0bn, +51.6%) was held at Q1 against a Q1 OP of 391m (3.0% ordinary progress against a 5-year average of 18.8%). Fuji's own record is three of three holds at H1 (FY24, FY25, FY26), with a cut only at Q3 (2026-01-08, OP 15.5bn to 10.6bn). This season Halows, Tenmaya Store, Okuwa and Heiwado all held their FY plans despite down H1 profit. Hold is therefore the base case, with roughly a 35% chance of a large cut at this print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 cut on 2026-01-08 (15:00 release): -1.42% on the day, -1.39% the next session, -2.78% in total. H1 prints with the plan held: 2025-10-10 -0.82/+1.50 (2-day +0.66), 2024-10-07 -1.58/+1.22 (-0.38), 2023-10-11 -1.06/+1.75 (+0.67) (Yahoo chart https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/8278.T?range=3y&interval=1d). Peer H1s this season with plans held, close to next close: Halows -1.15, Tenmaya -0.41, Okuwa +1.31, Heiwado +0.12.
findings.source_date: 2026-10-07 (財務データ更新); revision table covers 2023-04-12 to 2026-07-09
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The stock trades at 24x plan EPS (80.8) and sits near its 52-week low area after -3.7% over 20 days, so a cut is broadly expected. What is not priced is the timing: if the company follows its own habit and holds, the expected cut does not arrive in the window. A market that had fully priced a hold would not have drifted down into the print; a market that had fully priced a cut would show heavier margin longs selling, and margin longs are tiny (ratio 0.16).
findings.independence: Peer H1 tanshin, all showing 'no revision': Halows https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260925539958.pdf, Tenmaya Store https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261006546368.pdf, Okuwa https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260925540554.pdf, Heiwado https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120260930542868.pdf. The FY26 revision document is also on edinetdb (https://edinetdb.jp/company/E03118/earnings-forecasts/). The cut-risk side rests on the Q1 tanshin, the same document as finding 2's Q1 base, counted once here.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) monthly sales were weaker than Q1: existing stores 97.5/99.3/99.7%, all stores 94.2/95.8/96.3%, against Q1's 99.5/98.8/103.3 and 97.1/95.7/99.9. With 3 closures in Q2 and Q1 OP at 391m, H1 OP will land well below last year's 4,501m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 on 2026-07-09 (OP -79%, released 15:00): -3.50% on the day, +0.77% the next session. That miss had not been visible in the monthly sales; this one is.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The 月次 page is public, and June's comparison against last year's rice-shortage special demand was known. The only unpriced part is gross margin, which the monthly sales do not show. Management flagged 'improvement signs' in May, so the margin could surprise either way.
findings.independence: The Q1 supplementary data (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589986.pdf) shows Q1 gross margin down 0.76pt and SG&A down 2.1%: the same company, a different document.

outside_window.finding: If the plan is held at H1, the company's Q3-cut habit (2026-01-08 precedent) and an H2 requirement of about 14.5bn OP against last year's 6.7bn point to a cut at Q3, around 2027-01-08.

baseline_tension: Mild. The findings lean very slightly negative while the priced lean is +0.58 (margin-short-heavy, small run-down). The strongest positive the release could carry is a held forecast, which is the base case by the company's own record and this season's peers, together with a next-day bounce like those after the last three H1 prints. I looked for buybacks and dividend changes and found none, so the negative is kept near zero.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on 月次 or a public progress rate): the Q2 monthly-sales finding moved from -0.2 to -0.1, and p_up moved toward 50 (46 to 48).

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive (a held plan, the bounce habit) into baseline_tension. I had already looked for returns and the hold base rate, so the guidance finding moved only from -0.4 to -0.3, reflecting the hold being more likely than the cut.
